card.name: Just before a named corticosteroid drug
card.fires_on: Words and marks right before a steroid name such as methylprednisolone or dexamethasone in premedication lines, like 'intr-avenous', 'e.g.,' or 'mg/kg'. A weaker second case is 'of' or 'efficient' in fuel talk.

modes.label: Before steroid drug names
modes.description: Route words, 'e.g.,', 'such as' or dose units that come just before methylprednisolone or dexamethasone.

modes.label: Fuel and pump text
modes.description: Scattered words in web text about fuel, gasoline or ethanol, such as 'of' after gallons.
modes.example: collectively saving thousands of gallons<< of>> fuel a year and reducing pollution.

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated.
card.plain: It lights up in the spot where a steroid drug name is about to appear in a premedication instruction.
